description: Row-scan-with-condition questions over tables netdistill KEEPS (not elided). The table research says positional/tabular formats weaken here vs self-contained key=value objects, because the model must map a column position back to its header. This probes exactly that: netdistill:wire/toon (positional) vs netdistill:kv (self-contained). Graders are deterministic (must_contain all, must_not_contain none).

cases.question: Which neighbor device is connected over a 10-Gigabit (TenGigabit) port? Those have a Port ID starting with 'Te'. Give the device name.
Which routing tables / VRFs carry MORE THAN 2 BGP routes? List their names.
Which single routing table / VRF has MORE OSPF routes than BGP routes? Give just its name.
Which BGP neighbor IP address belongs to the peer-group named TRANSIT?
